$comment: Mailbox scopes. A scope is a saved filter over the same dataset, so different teams
or sites can be given a report showing only their own mailboxes.
To add a scope, copy a block below and give it a unique id. To hand someone a page
showing only that scope, send them  scope.html?scope=<id>  - or copy scope.html to a
new file and set  data-scope="<id>"  on its <body> tag for a clean URL.
Matching rules (all optional - omit anything you do not need):
includeGuids        exact ExchangeGuid values, the most durable way to pin a list
includeSmtp         SMTP patterns, '*' and '?' wildcards, or 're:' for a regex
includeDisplayName  display-name patterns, same wildcard rules
excludeSmtp         removed after includes are applied
excludeDisplayName  removed after includes are applied
minSizeGB           only mailboxes at or above this primary size
minUsagePercent     only mailboxes at or above this quota usage
A scope with no include rules matches every mailbox. Excludes always win.

scopes.name: Attention Required
scopes.description: Mailboxes at or above the warning threshold.

scopes.name: Large Mailboxes
scopes.description: Mailboxes holding 25 GB or more in the primary store.

scopes.name: Shared & Admin
scopes.description: Shared, service, and administrative mailboxes matched by name.

scopes.name: Example Site
scopes.description: Template - replace the GUIDs and patterns with a real site's mailboxes.
